user_message: How would you test whether a pendulum's period depends on bob mass, rather than merely asserting the textbook result?
allowed_evidence: For small angles and negligible resistance, the ideal simple-pendulum model gives T=2π√(L/g), which contains no bob mass.
public_rubric: Identifies variables to hold fixed and a useful measurement procedure.
Distinguishes the ideal prediction from real-world complications.
Explains what outcome would challenge the model.
